items.title: Baker Mayfield: Looking unlikely for Week 11
items.text:
The Buccaneers aren't ruling Mayfield (foot) out from playing in Sunday's game at Detroit, but the team views the quarterback as "probably a long shot for this week," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could be back around Week 16
items.text:
The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: 'Trending' toward sitting Week 11
items.text:
Mayfield (foot) "seems to be trending" toward sitting out Sunday's game against the Lions, with Jalon Daniels likely to draw the Week 11 start, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jalon Daniels: Could be headed for Week 11 start
items.text:
Daniels "seems to be trending" toward drawing the start at quarterback for the Buccaneers on Sunday in Detroit while Baker Mayfield tends to a foot strain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Marvin Harrison: Sits out practice again
items.text:
Harrison (hamstring) was a non-participant in Tuesday's practice.
